say:2:1530340001:1.text: What do you think? She's starving. A little food is all she needs.
say:2:1530340001:1.source_cn: 还能怎么样，就是饿……只要吃点东西就好。
say:2:1530340001:1.male: What do you think? She's starving. A little food is all she needs.
say:2:1530340001:1.female: What do you think? She's starving. A little food is all she needs.

say:3:1530340002:1.text: But that barley cake was the last of what we had.
say:3:1530340002:1.source_cn: 可是刚才的那块麦饼，是我们最后的食物了。
say:3:1530340002:1.male: But that barley cake was the last of what we had.
say:3:1530340002:1.female: But that barley cake was the last of what we had.

say:4:1530340003:1.text: O God of Harvest, please don't let us starve to death!
say:4:1530340003:1.source_cn: 丰饶神，请你保佑我们，我们不想饿死！
